title: validate-bulk-config-positive-values
request: add validation to BulkConfig so max_operations and max_payload_size must be > 0; currently negative values are accepted, I want a ValueError on init
reference_diff:
--- a/langfuse/api/scim/types/bulk_config.py
+++ b/langfuse/api/scim/types/bulk_config.py
@@ -17,6 +17,12 @@
         int, FieldMetadata(alias="maxPayloadSize")
     ]
 
+    @pydantic.field_validator('max_operations', 'max_payload_size')
+    def _positive_values(cls, v):
+        if v <= 0:
+            raise ValueError('must be positive')
+        return v
+
     model_config: typing.ClassVar[pydantic.ConfigDict] = pydantic.ConfigDict(
         extra="allow", frozen=True
     )
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_bulk_config_validation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import pytest
+from langfuse.api.scim.types.bulk_config import BulkConfig
+
+def test_bulk_config_negative_values_raise():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        BulkConfig(supported=True, max_operations=-5, max_payload_size=10)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        BulkConfig(supported=True, max_operations=5, max_payload_size=0)
+
+def test_bulk_config_valid():
+    cfg = BulkConfig(supported=False, max_operations=5, max_payload_size=10)
+    assert cfg.max_operations == 5
+    assert cfg.max_payload_size == 10
